root_cause_label: Network-Blocked Web Search Prevents Official Code Discovery
one_sentence_failure_summary: All outbound web search endpoints (DuckDuckGo, GitHub API, Papers With Code, arXiv, proxy services) were blocked in the sandbox, making it impossible to dynamically discover official code repositories for 5 of the 10 papers despite 70+ fallback attempts across the full 79-step trajectory.
t_err_evidence: writes /app/result.jsonl from a pipeline relying on unavailable pdftotext/strings, yielding empty results
t_commit_evidence: At step 7, result.jsonl is first written with all empty URLs; the agent's subsequent behavior (70+ steps of alternative search attempts) never overcomes the network block, and 5 of 10 entries remain empty throughout, making the failing outcome locked in from this step.
t_surface_evidence: all ten lines show official_code_url empty: {"paper_id": "1", "official_code_url": ""}
trigger_explanation: The sandbox blocked all outbound HTTP requests to web search endpoints (DuckDuckGo, GitHub REST API, Papers With Code, arXiv). The agent attempted DuckDuckGo at step 7 without first testing network connectivity, received silent empty results rather than explicit errors, and then spent 70+ steps cycling through alternative scraping proxies (r.jina.ai, Papers With Code HTML, GitHub HTML search, arXiv API) all of which were equally blocked. The environment blocker was real and structural; the mishandling was the agent's failure to diagnose it early and pivot to a purely knowledge-based fallback for all 10 papers.
